```{r}
#| layout-ncol: 5
#| echo: false
library(gt)

gt(
  read.csv("pub_list.csv") |> 
  dplyr::transmute(Title, Author, 
                   Journal = ifelse((Publication.Title == ""), "Preprint - medRxiv", Publication.Title), Year = substr(Date, 1, 4),
                   #DOI = paste0("<a href=\"http://doi.org/", DOI, "\">", DOI, "</a>")
                   DOI = paste0("http://doi.org/", DOI) 
                   ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(-as.numeric(Year), !grepl("Preprint", Journal))) |>
  fmt_url(columns = DOI) |>
  text_transform(
    locations = cells_body(columns = Author),
    fn = function(x) {
      lapply(x, function(author_list) {

        author_vec <- strsplit(author_list, ";")[[1]]

        short <- paste(
          head(author_vec, 3),
          collapse = "; "
        )

        paste0(
          "<span class='author-tooltip'>",
          short, ", et al.",
          "<span class='tooltip-text'>",
          author_list,
          "</span>",
          "</span>"
        )
      })
    }
  )


  

```
